newsitem.title: USA: Corning says to build 2nd fiber plant.
newsitem.headline: Corning says to build 2nd fiber plant.

text.p: Corning Inc said on Monday it will locate its U.S. optical fiber manufacturing plant in Cabarrus County, N.C.
Corning will use the added capacity to meet the rapidly expanding worldwide requirements of its customers, complementing its Wilmington, N.C., fiber plant, the company said.
Corning will invest several hundred million dollars in the new facility to be located near Midland, N.C.
Construction is expected to begin in early 1997, with initial production scheduled for 1999, Corning said.
